name: Persian knowledge domain queries with follow-up
description: Tests the Persian knowledge shelf integration. The user asks about Stoic philosophy in Persian, then about focus/concentration, then transitions to a personal anxiety topic. Verifies that Persian knowledge responses are returned with Persian text (حروف فارسی), that the knowledge module returns domain-appropriate content, and that natural topic routing resumes after knowledge queries.

turns.text: ممنون. من خیلی نگران آینده‌ام هستم

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: Persian knowledge matches 'رواقی' hint -> thinkers domain. Response contains Persian text. Turn 2: 'تمرکز' hint -> focus domain but dialogueAct is 'question' since input has question mark. Persian response. Turn 3: transitions to anxiety with natural engine routing via 'نگران'.
expected.behavior: Persian knowledge domainHints map Persian keywords to domains. answer('fa', domain) returns Persian text. Knowledge responses are independent copies. Question turns maintain dialogueAct 'question'. Topic tracking continues after knowledge.
